🚆 One day of trains in Poland — Thursday 15 October 2026.

6,784 trains across 2,980 stations, from PKP Intercity's Pendolinos to every regional operator. Warsaw, the Tricity, Silesia and Kraków light up first. Peaks: 706 trains on the move at 06:54, 736 at 16:45.

📊 Data: PKP PLK & Koleje Mazowieckie open data, GTFS by Mikołaj Kuranowski (mkuran.pl). Every train follows the real track geometry (GTFS shapes); positions interpolated between stops.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
